# ClawSkills
> The definitive directory for OpenClaw AI agent skills.

## About
ClawSkills is the most comprehensive resource for discovering, comparing, and installing OpenClaw skills. We catalog 5,705+ skills across 10 categories with curated reviews, security analysis, and one-click installation commands.

## Pages
- / — Homepage with featured skills, articles, and tutorials
- /skills — Browse 5,705+ OpenClaw skills across 10 categories with search and filtering
- /skills/ai-llms — AI & LLMs skills: prompt chaining, model routing, RAG pipelines, embeddings
- /skills/search-research — Search & Research skills: web scraping, academic search, deep research
- /skills/web-frontend — Web & Frontend Dev skills: React, CSS, deployment, testing
- /skills/devops-cloud — DevOps & Cloud skills: CI/CD, containers, infrastructure, monitoring
- /skills/browser-automation — Browser & Automation skills: web scraping, form filling, UI testing
- /skills/productivity — Productivity & Tasks skills: calendars, notes, task management
- /skills/marketing-sales — Marketing & Sales skills: email, social media, analytics, CRM
- /skills/coding-agents — Coding Agents & IDEs skills: code generation, refactoring, IDE plugins
- /skills/notes-pkm — Notes & PKM skills: Notion, Obsidian, personal knowledge management
- /skills/health-fitness — Health & Fitness skills: tracking, nutrition, workout planning
- /articles — In-depth reviews and "best skills for X" comparison articles
- /tutorials — Step-by-step installation and development guides for all skill levels

## Key Features
- One-click install commands: `npx clawhub@latest install <skill-name>`
- Security status indicators: Verified, Community, Unreviewed
- Skill ratings and reviews
- Related skills and alternatives
- FAQ sections for every skill
- Compatibility information (macOS, Linux, Windows WSL)

## Content Types
- Skill Pages: Detailed reference pages with install commands, use cases, FAQs, compatibility, and alternatives
- Articles: Long-form "best of" lists reviewing 5-10 skills per category
- Tutorials: Step-by-step guides from beginner to advanced levels

## Contact
- Website: https://clawskills.com
- Not affiliated with OpenClaw.
